sources.title: nom-vn/training/diacritic/README.md at main · nrl-ai/nom-vn
sources.snippet: ByT5-small (300 M, char-level, robust to typos per arXiv:2201.13242) is the canonical SOTA for VN diacritic restoration in the literature, but needs ~4× longer sequences (it's byte-level) and is queued for v0.2.25 only if v0.2.24 fails the gate.
